close.title: Minimize to tray or quit?
close.description: You are still connected. Minimized, Mumcord keeps you in voice and stays in the system tray.
close.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
close.descriptionServers: You are still connected to {{count}} servers. Minimized, Mumcord keeps you in voice and stays in the system tray.

windowOverlay.title: The window overlay was removed
windowOverlay.description: The floating overlay window is gone. The in-game overlay shows who is talking inside your games instead. You can switch it on in the overlay settings.

audioDevice.title: Choose your audio devices again
audioDevice.description: Mumcord now lists every input and output of your audio devices separately. Your saved device could not be matched to one of them, so the system default is used for now. You can pick a device in the audio settings.

appImageMenu.title: Add Mumcord to the app menu?
appImageMenu.description: This puts Mumcord in your app menu. It makes the icon and push-to-talk work properly on Wayland, and lets mumble:// links open Mumcord. You can change this later in Settings.
appImageMenu.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

updateCheck.title: Check for new versions?
updateCheck.description: Mumcord can ask GitHub regularly whether a newer version exists and tell you about it. Nothing is downloaded or installed without asking you, and nothing is sent except the request itself and the app name and version. You can change this later in Settings.
updateCheck.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

directConsent.title: Allow direct connections?
directConsent.description: Direct connections are faster, but the other person can see your IP address. Mumcord uses them for full-size images and screen sharing with other Mumcord users and may open a port on your router for them. If you say no, images still arrive through the server and screen sharing is unavailable. You can change this later in Settings → Privacy. If this server offers a relay, Mumcord can use it instead; then the other person doesn't see your IP address.
directConsent.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
